cases.translation: Pilate asked Jesus: 'Are you the King of the Jews?'
cases.explain: Пилат is the subject of the verb спросил, so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.translation: And this continued until the ninth hour.
cases.explain: The preposition до (until) governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: Pilate said to the chief priests and to the crowd.
cases.explain: Толпе is the indirect object of сказал (said to), which takes the dative case.

cases.sentence: Солдаты разделили между собой ___ Иисуса, бросив жеребий.
cases.translation: The soldiers divided Jesus's clothing among themselves, casting lots.
cases.explain: Одежду is the direct object of разделили (to divide something), so it takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Ведь если с молодым и зеленым ___ делают такое, то что же будет с сухим?
cases.translation: For if they do this with the green tree, what will happen with the dry one?
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) governs the instrumental case here.

cases.sentence: Солнце померкло, и завеса в ___ разорвалась на две части.
cases.translation: The sun was darkened, and the curtain in the temple tore into two pieces.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) governs the prepositional case for location.

reading.question: What did the crowd do after bringing Jesus before Pilate?
reading.explain: The text says they began to accuse him before Pilate.

reading.ru: И узнав, что Иисус был из области подвластной Ироду, который тоже был в это время в Иерусалиме, он послал Иисуса к нему.
reading.question: Why did Pilate send Jesus to Herod?
options: Because Jesus was from a region under Herod's jurisdiction
Because Pilate was leaving the city
Because Jesus asked to see Herod
reading.correct: Because Jesus was from a region under Herod's jurisdiction
reading.explain: Pilate learned Jesus was from Herod's jurisdiction and sent him there.

reading.ru: Ирод, увидев Иисуса, очень обрадовался, потому что уже давно хотел его увидеть.
reading.question: How did Herod react upon seeing Jesus?
options: He was very glad, having long wanted to see him
reading.correct: He was very glad, having long wanted to see him
reading.explain: The text states Herod was very glad because he had long wanted to see Jesus.

reading.ru: В этот день Ирод и Пилат стали друзьями, а прежде они враждовали.
reading.question: What happened between Herod and Pilate that day?
options: They became friends, though they had been enemies before
reading.correct: They became friends, though they had been enemies before
reading.explain: The text says Herod and Pilate became friends that day, having been enemies before.

reading.ru: Тогда все в один голос закричали «Смерть ему! Отпусти нам Варавву!»
reading.question: What did the crowd shout to Pilate?
options: "Death to him! Release Barabbas to us!"
reading.correct: "Death to him! Release Barabbas to us!"
reading.explain: The crowd shouted together demanding Jesus's death and Barabbas's release.

reading.ru: Конвоиры схватили некоего Симона из Керены, шедшего с поля.
reading.question: Who was seized to carry Jesus's cross?
reading.explain: The guards seized Simon of Cyrene, who was coming from the field.

reading.ru: Дочери Иерусалима, не плачьте обо мне, плачьте лучше о себе и о своих детях.
reading.question: What did Jesus tell the women of Jerusalem who were mourning him?
options: Not to weep for him but for themselves and their children
To follow him all the way to Galilee
reading.correct: Not to weep for him but for themselves and their children
reading.explain: Jesus told the daughters of Jerusalem to weep for themselves and their children, not for him.

reading.ru: Иисус говорил, «Отец, прости им, ведь они не знают, что делают».
reading.question: What did Jesus say about those crucifying him?
options: "Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing"
reading.correct: "Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they are doing"
reading.explain: On the cross Jesus asked the Father to forgive those who did not know what they were doing.

reading.ru: Сегодня ты будешь со мной в раю», — ответил ему Иисус.
reading.question: What did Jesus promise the repentant criminal on the cross?
options: That he would be with Jesus in paradise that very day
That he would soon be released
That his sins were not forgiven
That he would see his family again
reading.correct: That he would be with Jesus in paradise that very day
reading.explain: Jesus told the repentant criminal he would be with him in paradise that day.

reading.ru: Солнце померкло, и завеса в храме разорвалась на две части.
reading.question: What happened at the moment of Jesus's death?
options: The sun was darkened and the temple curtain tore in two
reading.correct: The sun was darkened and the temple curtain tore in two
reading.explain: The text describes darkness and the tearing of the temple curtain at that moment.

reading.ru: Когда сотник все это увидел, он прославил Бога и сказал, «Этот человек действительно был праведником».
reading.question: What did the centurion say after witnessing Jesus's death?
reading.explain: The centurion glorified God and declared that Jesus was truly a righteous man.

reading.ru: Этот человек пошел к Пилату и попросил тело Иисуса.
reading.question: What did Joseph of Arimathea do after Jesus's death?
options: He went to Pilate and asked for Jesus's body
He fled the city in fear
He joined the soldiers guarding the tomb
reading.correct: He went to Pilate and asked for Jesus's body
reading.explain: Joseph of Arimathea went to Pilate and asked for the body of Jesus.
